headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty ended mixed amid Fed rate hike concerns and NSE IPO updates.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Fed rate hike concerns impacted investor sentiment during the last trading session.
US sanctions on Russia and Middle East geopolitical tensions added to market uncertainty.
Fluctuating FII inflows and crude oil price movements kept market gains constrained.
Mixed signals from Asian peers including Nikkei and Kospi influenced domestic trading action.
whatHappening: Over 150 stocks including IRCTC and BEML have record dates for corporate actions this week.
Ten midcap companies reported their highest quarterly profits in ten quarters.
Nine penny stocks experienced sharp corrections, falling up to 67% in three months.
Paytm remains in focus as markets prepare for the upcoming trading week.
summary:
Indian equity markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, September 21.
During the previous trading session, benchmark indices ended mixed amid Fed rate hike fears and global headwinds.
Focus for the upcoming week shifts to stock-specific corporate actions, crude oil prices, and foreign institutional flows.
